glosses: vamp (woman who uses sexual desire to exploit men)

examples.text: Vampiros devem beber sangue para sobreviver.
examples.en: Vampires must drink blood to survive.

examples.text: Eu tive um pesadelo sobre vampiros.
examples.en: I had a nightmare about vampires.

examples.text: Tom não estava vestido de vampiro. Ele estava vestido de pirata.
examples.en: Tom wasn't dressed as a vampire. He was dressed as a pirate.
